source.enumeration_note: ONE PART (g2a) of twelve; registers/merge-parts.py merges them into registers/encoding-roadmap.json, whose enumeration is complete (434 units, every article number 1–361).

units.title: Homicídio simples
units.note: Every paragraph: caput and § 3º (the crime, intentional — consummated or attempted, art. 14 — or culpable), § 1º (the privilege, a cause of decrease; fork F-g2a-01 on which qualifiers admit it, F-g2a-02 on 'pode'), § 2º I–X (the qualified form, one preceito for all ten incisos; VI revoked by Lei nº 14.994/2024 and shown '(Revogado)'), § 2º-B and § 2º-C (causes of increase), § 2º-D (qualified form, 20–40 years, from 25.3.2026), § 4º (both sentences; F-g2a-03 on § 4º's 'menor de 14' beside § 2º IX), § 5º (the judicial pardon, returned as an option), § 6º (cause; F-g2a-05 beside § 2º-D). § 2º-A and § 7º are '(Revogado)' in the source and carry no rule. Temporal scope: penalty rules answer for facts from 10.10.2024 (Lei nº 14.994/2024, which revoked § 2º VI, § 2º-A and § 7º) and refuse earlier; a fact before 7.5.2025 that only § 2º VII would qualify refuses (VII re-written by Lei nº 15.134/2025); § 2º X and § 2º-C apply from 4.7.2025, § 2º-D from 25.3.2026. Tests in cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4.

units.title: Feminicídio
units.note: Caput (the crime, consummated or attempted, from 10.10.2024), § 1º (the razões, as input findings; § 1º I read as Lei nº 11.340/2006 art. 5º defines it — reserved fork F-sweep-b-08, M-sweep-b-17), § 2º (one cause of 1/3 to 1/2 for any of I–V; V borrows the conditions of art. 121 § 2º III, IV and VIII and keeps its own fraction; F-g2a-06 on 'nos 3 meses posteriores ao parto'), § 3º (communication to the co-agent; F-g2a-07). Which of arts. 121, 121-A and 121-B governs a killing: F-g2a-04. Tests in cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4.

units.title: Vicaricídio
units.note: Caput (the crime, consummated or attempted, from 10.4.2026 — Lei nº 15.384/2026; before it the killing is art. 121's) and parágrafo único (one cause of 1/3 to 1/2 for any of I–III; criança, adolescente and idoso as cp-pena reads them, forks F-g0-24 and F-g0-08). Tests in cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4.

units.title: Lesão corporal
units.note: Every paragraph: caput and § 6º (the crime, intentional — consummated or attempted — or culpable; a death the agent wanted or risked is homicide, not art. 129), §§ 1º and 2º (the grades, computed from the incisos the medical report attests; `a natureza da lesão (art. 129, §§ 1º e 2º)` gives the shared Resultado, F-g2a-11), § 3º and § 3º-A (followed by death; § 3º-A from 25.3.2026), § 4º (cause of decrease), § 5º (the judge's option; its fine in réis is inert and the substituted fine is art. 49's day-fine — binding entry M-sweep-b-07), §§ 7º, 8º-A, 10, 11 and 12 (causes of increase; § 7º borrows the conditions of art. 121 §§ 4º and 6º and keeps its own 1/3, F-g2a-10), § 8º (art. 121 § 5º's pardon, as an option), §§ 9º and 13 (the domestic and gender forms of the slight injury, F-g2a-09). The ação penal, which the Code does not state, from Lei nº 9.099/1995 art. 88 and Lei nº 11.340/2006 art. 41 with STJ Súmula 542 (binding entry M-sweep-b-16, reserved fork F-sweep-b-07). Temporal scope: penalty rules answer from 10.10.2024 (Lei nº 14.994/2024 re-wrote § 9º's pena and § 13) and refuse earlier; a fact before 2.7.2026 on which § 9º bears refuses (§ 9º re-worded by Lei nº 15.455/2026), and so do the causes of a fact before 4.7.2025 on which § 12 bears (Lei nº 15.159/2025). Tests in cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4.
